title: Formalization of power weight inequalities for spherical maximal functions
abstract: This is a Lean 4 formalization of Theorem 1.1 from the paper "Power weight inequalities for spherical maximal functions" by Marco Fraccaroli, Joris Roos, and Andreas Seeger, arXiv:2602.17613. The formalized result concerns boundedness of  spherical maximal functions with arbitrary sets of dilations and radial power weights. The allowable exponent and weight ranges are characterized, apart from endpoint boundedness, by the Legendre-Assouad function of the dilation set. This resolved an open problem of Duoandikoetxea and Seijo up to endpoints. The main theorem statement in Lean was human-generated, while the formal proofs where machine-generated by coding agents under human supervision following the mathematical source directly.
